notes: API 36 arm64 emulator on this Mac, same AVD, 1600x2400 px / density 320, read-only instance, speed AOT compilation. Three runs per workload except one idle capture. No physical-device result.

The emulator stopped during intervening JVM/iOS work; candidate used a fresh read-only instance of the same AVD. Baseline had also initially used a fresh read-only instance. This is a sequential, restarted comparison, not randomized interleaving.
Timing summaries are medians of per-run percentiles or totals. Gesture settlement summaries pool the six explicitly identified gestures per variant. Raw per-run metrics and gesture rows are retained.
App and stage CPU are scheduled time; wall slices include descheduling. Parallel threads can consume more CPU than elapsed time. Inclusive GC/driver parent and child slices must not be summed.

gfx completion = FrameCompleted - IntendedVsync, not input-to-display. Deadline denominator is eligible valid rows. Cold flagged first frames are excluded by gfxinfo but appear as missed in FrameTimeline; do not claim zero cold misses.
Main-window FrameTimeline rows linked to numbered UI doFrames have a different population from all-window FrameTimeline and gfxinfo. Switch gfxinfo truncates history and includes multiple windows.

Cold first-material frame has all seven initial Applied markers and their common presentation in both builds. First-material frame-start to presentation excludes earlier launch work. am start -W measures launch completion.
No GPU slice or hardware GPU counter tracks are recorded. Native shader_compile/flush is CPU/driver wall evidence, not GPU execution. Graphics=0 in meminfo is incomplete emulator accounting.
Heap counter maxima and post-capture PSS depend on GC and process history. No exact Android allocation-rate or leak claim is supported. Idle snapshots are single samples.
Lower candidate heap peaks coexist with more background GC cycles/CPU. A smaller live heap affecting ART thresholds is a possible explanation, not established by these traces.
Attempted baseline scroll did not scroll the fitted pane and is excluded. The seven-component workloads exercise multiple components.
Raw traces, paired gfxinfo and meminfo remain in each variant directory. Trace hashes identify exactly the input used. Review JSON retains each frame and revision row.
